playersNote.zh: 另需 1 位说书人。盒子写 5 人起，但人太少撑不起来
playersNote.en: plus 1 Storyteller. The box starts at 5, but it needs a crowd to work

blurb.zh: 镇民找恶魔，恶魔藏到最后；死了还能发言投票。
blurb.en: Dead players keep talking. Werewolf, finally perfected.

desc.zh: 得有个人当说书人。好人要找出恶魔，恶魔要活到最后。跟狼人杀最不一样的地方是，你被杀了照样能发言、还剩一票，所以没人干坐着等散场。策略深度比狼人杀和阿瓦隆都高一截，上手要花点时间，玩明白了就很难回去了。
desc.en: One player runs the game as Storyteller. The town hunts the Demon; the Demon survives to the end. The twist: dying doesn't remove you — you still speak, still vote once. Nobody sits out.

notes.zh: 四套内容都有：暗流涌动（新手先玩这个）、黯月初升、梦殒春宵，还有华灯初上——它是角色合集，不能单独开，得配自定义剧本用。
notes.en: We own four sets: Trouble Brewing (start here), Bad Moon Rising, Sects & Violets, and Temple Fair — a character collection rather than a standalone script, so it needs a custom script to play.

blurb.zh: 拿宝石、买卡，买到的卡又变成下一张的折扣。
blurb.en: Take gems, buy cards, snowball. Thirty minutes, gone.

desc.zh: 攒宝石、买卡，买到的卡变成永久折扣，越往后一回合能干的事越多。桌上的牌和宝石就那么多，看着简单其实全是勾心斗角。轻策常青树，推新最稳的一款，易学难精。
desc.en: Collect gem chips, spend them on development cards, and every card you buy becomes a permanent discount — so each turn does more than the last. Five minutes to teach. The safest game to hand a first-timer.

name.zh: 犯罪现场：CSI 还原真相

blurb.zh: 法医只能摆证物说话，而凶手就坐在桌上。
blurb.en: The forensic scientist can't speak. The murderer is at the table.

desc.zh: 一个人当法医，只能靠摆「死因」和「线索」标记给提示；其他人从满桌凶器证物里拼出凶手到底用的哪一套。人越多越热闹，规则十分钟讲完，聚会上最容易炸场的那种。
desc.en: One player is the forensic scientist and may never talk — they can only place tiles marking cause of death and key evidence. Everyone else reads those clues to work out which weapon and which clue actually belong to the killer. Scales beautifully to a crowd, teaches in ten minutes.

playersNote.zh: 盒子写 2 人起，但 4 个人才凑得成两队
playersNote.en: the box starts at 2, but you need 4 to make two teams

blurb.zh: 一个词加一个数字，看队友能不能读懂你。
blurb.en: One word, one number. Now pray your friends think like you.

desc.zh: 两队各出一个军师，只能说「一个词＋一个数字」，让队友从 5×5 的词阵里挑出自己人。碰到刺客那格直接输。人多了也不怕，围观的往往比上场的还激动。
desc.en: Each team's spymaster gives a single word and a number, and their team has to pick their own agents out of a 5×5 grid of words. One square is the assassin — touch it and you lose on the spot. Add as many people as you like; the spectators end up shouting too.

blurb.zh: 传情报、藏身份，一句话就能把人送走。
blurb.en: Pass the intel, hide your allegiance, talk someone into the ground.

desc.zh: 电影《风声》改的身份局。红蓝两方加第三方各有各的赢法，靠传情报和互相试探摸底。单局短、重开快，一晚上能连打好几把。
desc.en: A hidden-role game built on the Chinese spy film Fengsheng. Two intelligence factions plus a third party each chase different win conditions, passing intelligence cards around and calling each other out. Short games, fast resets — you'll play five in a row.

blurb.zh: 梅林知道一切，但不能让莫德雷德认出他是谁。
blurb.en: Merlin knows everything — and must never let it show.

desc.zh: 好人做成三个任务就赢，坏人搅黄三个、或者最后一刀刺中梅林也能翻盘。全程没人出局，所有人从头吵到尾。七人局最经典，也最容易翻车。
desc.en: Good needs three successful quests; evil needs three failures — or one correct guess at Merlin in the final moment. Nobody is ever eliminated, so everyone argues from start to finish. Seven players is the classic count.

name.zh: 三国杀（典藏版 + 国战）

blurb.zh: 主公忠臣反贼内奸，国民级身份局。
blurb.en: Lord, loyalists, rebels, and one traitor. China's household hidden-role game.

desc.zh: 典藏版含标准版＋军争篇＋风火扩展，再加一套国战，武将和牌堆都齐了。四种身份各有各的赢法，人多的时候最闹。规则基本不用讲，随便凑几个人就能开。
desc.en: The Collector's Edition bundles the base game with the Warfare and Wind/Fire expansions, and we have Kingdom Wars alongside it, so the full hero roster is here. Everyone draws a secret role — Lord, Loyalist, Rebel, or Traitor — each with its own win condition, and plays a character with unique powers. Loud and chaotic at high counts.

playersNote.zh: 身份局 4–10 人；国战模式可到 12 人，军争篇另含 1v1 与 3v3
playersNote.en: 4–10 in hidden-role mode; Kingdom Wars goes to 12, and Warfare adds 1v1 and 3v3

blurb.zh: 选身份、暗杀、结盟，五分钟一局的极速狼人。
blurb.en: Pick a role, stab someone, betray a friend. Five minutes a round.

desc.zh: 两家互相潜伏。每轮先挑身份，间谍和占卜师拿情报，只有忍者和盲刺客能动手。节奏快到不太给你思考时间，一晚上能打十几把。官方还配了 2 人规则。
desc.en: Two houses, both infiltrated. Each round you choose which ninja to be: a Spy or Fortune Teller gathers information, but only a Shinobi or Blind Assassin can actually take someone out. Rounds are so short that losing just means dealing again.

blurb.zh: 只过一个晚上，投一次票，没人出局。
blurb.en: One night, one vote, ten minutes. Nobody sits out.

desc.zh: 狼人杀的极速版，一个夜晚加一次投票就完事。身份在夜里会被换来换去，你看到的那张未必还是你自己的。配 App 主持，不用专门抓个人当法官。
desc.en: Werewolf compressed to a single night and one vote. Roles get swapped around in the dark, so the card you looked at may no longer be who you are. The companion app narrates, so nobody has to sit out as moderator.

playersNote.zh: 盒子印的是 3–10 人，我们玩下来 8 个人往上才够味
playersNote.en: the box says 3–10; we find it wants 8 or more to really work

blurb.zh: 骰子决定你能拿哪块板块，一格一格拼出自己的领地。
blurb.en: The dice-placement classic. Every turn is an efficiency puzzle.

desc.zh: 两颗骰子决定你能拿哪块板块、摆在哪儿，一格一格把领地填满。核心行动就四五种，规则不复杂，但每一步都在算性价比。2011 年到现在稳在 BGG 前 20，重开性极高。
desc.en: Two dice decide which tiles you can take and where they can go, and you fill in your estate hex by hex. Completing regions triggers chain scoring, so every turn is a choice between taking what's there and holding out for the better fit. A textbook euro, and it never gets old.

blurb.zh: 掷骰选行动，把小咖啡馆经营成维也纳大饭店。
blurb.en: Turn a Viennese café into the hotel the emperor visits.

desc.zh: 所有人共用一堆骰子，点数决定这轮能做什么，但拿走一颗，那个行动就弱一分。招员工、备酒水、把客人安排进对的房间，员工之间的连锁才是真正的核心。中策偏重，思考时间长，双人局反而比四人更紧凑。
desc.en: A shared pool of dice sets which actions are available each round, but what you do with them is entirely yours. Hire staff, stock the bar, seat guests in the right rooms — the staff combos are where the game really lives. Mid-heavy euro that stays tight at two.

blurb.zh: 不能说话的合作吃墩，96 关一路打下去。
blurb.en: Co-op trick-taking where you're barely allowed to speak. 96 missions deep.

desc.zh: 规则像简化版桥牌，跟色出牌、数字大的赢墩。难点在于每局都有指定任务（比如「红 3 必须我来吃」），全程不许交流，每人只有一枚提示标记能用。96 关难度递进，任务卡随机抽，可以当战役慢慢推。
desc.en: Trick-taking, but cooperative. Each mission hands out tasks like "I must win the red 3" — and you may not discuss them. One communication token per player is all the signalling you get. 96 missions of escalating difficulty, playable as a long campaign.

blurb.zh: 一句话形容一张画，说太准和说太玄都会输。
blurb.en: Describe the picture. Too clear loses. Too clever loses too.

desc.zh: 讲故事的人给自己那张画编个谜面，其他人各丢一张出来混淆，然后大家猜哪张是原牌。全猜中和全没猜中，讲故事的人都是零分，分寸得卡得刚刚好。这游戏很看人，跟脑洞大的人玩才尽兴。
desc.en: The storyteller gives a clue for one of their dreamlike cards; everyone else submits a card to muddy the water, then all players guess which was the original. The catch: if everyone guesses right, or everyone guesses wrong, the storyteller scores nothing. The clue has to land exactly in between.

blurb.zh: 同样的梦幻插画，这次比的是猜大家会怎么想。
blurb.en: Same dreamlike art — but now you're guessing how everyone else thinks.

desc.zh: Dixit 世界观下的竞速版。给一个词，所有人同时在板上圈自己觉得沾边的牌。跟别人圈得一样才得分，圈了没人要的反而倒扣。最要命的是不知道什么时候该收手，贪一张就可能全盘皆输。
desc.en: A race set in the Dixit universe. One word is revealed, and everyone simultaneously marks the cards they think connect to it. Matching other players scores; going out alone costs you. The real decision is when to stop — push too far and the round collapses.

alt.zh: 繁中版《DaVinci code 终极密码》；日版 Algo，国际版 Coda

blurb.zh: 黑白数字牌，猜错一次就得翻开自己一张。
blurb.en: Black and white number tiles. Guess wrong and you expose yourself.

desc.zh: 每人一排藏着的数字牌，按大小排好，轮流猜别人的。猜中了对方翻开，猜错了自己翻开。规则三句话讲完，推理空间却意外地深，两个人玩也完全成立。
desc.en: Everyone holds a row of hidden numbered tiles in sorted order. Guess an opponent's tile correctly and they flip it; guess wrong and you flip one of your own. Three sentences of rules hiding a genuinely deep deduction game — and it's excellent at two.

blurb.zh: 便携版国粹，凑齐四个人就能开。
blurb.en: Travel-sized mahjong. Find three friends and you're playing.

desc.zh: 缩小版麻将，出门旅行随身带。三个人也能打，四人才是正经局。规则按你们熟的那套来就行。
desc.en: A shrunk-down mahjong set that fits in one small box and travels anywhere. Three can play, but four is the real game. House rules welcome — we play whichever variant the table knows.

blurb.zh: 一副牌、一箱筹码，规则你们都会。
blurb.en: A deck, a case of chips, and rules everybody already knows.

desc.zh: 筹码管够，想什么时候开就什么时候开。两个人单挑到十人满桌都行，打多久完全看你们自己。
desc.en: A full chip set, ready whenever someone suggests it. Heads-up at two, or a full table at ten. It runs as long as you want it to.

playersNote.zh: 筹码管够，卡人数的是那副牌——理论上最多能坐 22 个
playersNote.en: We have chips for days; the only limit is one deck of cards — 22 players, theoretically
